The ideas behind the screens

Progress on the plan

  • The plan as a coordinate map

    The idea is that the DWG plan becomes a map of points, each with its planned depth or level.

  • Photos tied to a place

    Designed so every photo, from a phone, a fixed camera or a drone, belongs to a coordinate on the plan.

  • Progress and deviation alerts

    Designed to show progress at each point and for the whole site, and to alert the team when work moves away from the plan.

  • Cost linked to measured work

    The idea is to link measured quantities to contract rates, so invoicing can follow the work actually done.

Measure and connect

  • Soil and rock volumes

    Designed to estimate how much soil and rock has been excavated and how much remains, from the same photos.

  • BIM and supplier data

    The idea is to bring in BIM models and supplier data, so the plan, deliveries and progress can be compared in one place.

  • Cameras, drones and connectivity

    Designed to work with fixed site cameras, drone flights and the mobile connection a site already has.

Safety and assets

  • Machine and worker safety

    The idea is to flag when a person is inside a machine's working zone, without identifying who it is.

  • Unidentified objects when digging

    Designed to flag unexpected objects in an excavation, so the team can stop and check.

  • Utility cable checks

    Can help compare the dig with utility plans, as a reminder to check for cables and pipes before work continues.

  • Structure condition monitoring

    The idea is to follow changes in structures such as dam walls over time, from repeated photos.

We deliver the software and help implement it on site: set-up, connectivity and testing.

The safety ideas are concepts. They do not replace site safety procedures or utility location services.
